notes: Astellas reports JPY billions to one decimal, cumulative within its April-March fiscal year (Q1 YTD, first half, nine months, full year). Fiscal Q1 (April-June) is the first-quarter YTD and is a direct read (calendar Q2); every other quarter is the YTD less the preceding YTD, so each fiscal year's four quarters sum exactly to the printed full-year figure (FY2018 2.5, FY2019 14.3, FY2020 23.8, FY2021 34.1, FY2022 46.6, FY2023 55.1, FY2024 68.0, FY2025 71.8) and a derived quarter carries up to 0.1 billion yen of rounding. Fiscal-to-calendar mapping: fiscal Q1 = calendar Q2, Q2 = Q3, Q3 = Q4, Q4 = next year's Q1. 2018Q4 (0.6) is read from the prior-year column of the Q3 FY2019 document because Astellas's own Q3 FY2018 document prints no XOSPATA sales line, only the December 2018 launch statement; Q1 and Q2 FY2018 predate the launch (the Q1 FY2019 and Q2 FY2019 documents print a dash for the prior year). Global line: the supplementary documents break XOSPATA into United States, Japan, Established Markets, China and International Markets and the regions sum to the total (Q1 FY2026: 9.6 + 1.5 + 6.5 + 1.5 + 2.6 = 21.7 against 21.6 printed, rounding). Latest point 2026Q2 is fiscal Q1 FY2026 (results of 2026-08-05 per Bigdata.com transcript).
search_log: Bigdata.com search 'Astellas Xospata revenue by region quarterly financial results' located the Q1 FY2026 earnings call (XOSPATA JPY 21.6 billion) and showed Astellas reports cumulative YTD figures; originals were then taken from astellas.com.

Collected every financial-results PDF link on https://www.astellas.com/en/investors/financial-results-library (138 files: results, presentations, supplementary documents, call scripts for FY2017-FY2026), downloaded them and extracted text with pdfplumber; read the 'XOSPATA' row of the '<Sales of Main Products> (Billions of yen)' table in each main results document.

Q3 FY2018 results (October-December 2018) mention the December 2018 launch but print no XOSPATA figure; the Q3 FY2019 results document's prior-year column (0.6) is used and flagged direct_prior_year_column.
Astellas is not an SEC registrant, so no 6-K/20-F exists; SEC EDGAR was not searched. Rung c (partners) was not searched because Astellas itself prints a worldwide line for the whole span.
Cross-check: for each fiscal year, four derived/direct quarters sum to the printed full-year XOSPATA figure.
